usage: 科學 (fo1 hok6) is used as a noun referring to the systematic study of the structure and behavior of the natural and physical world through observation and experimentation.
It can refer to the academic subject, a body of knowledge, or the scientific method.
In Cantonese sentences, 科學 often acts as the subject or object of a verb.
When talking about school subjects, you can say 我學科學 (ngo5 hok6 fo1 hok6) to mean 'I study science.'
It does not usually combine directly with measure words, but can form part of compound nouns or phrases.
